subject: TÜV SÜD and Accenture present Physical AI Safety Suite concept
summary: TÜV SÜD and Accenture presented an NVIDIA-based safety-evidence workflow concept covering facilities, fleets and individual robots; TÜV SÜD retains certification responsibility. The estimate of up to 30% faster activation is aspirational, not an independently measured outcome. The concept is not a completed third-party certification or a cross-vendor standard.
